notes.title: Racing game《LOLI RACING》has been officially launched on Steam (Update 1.1.0)
notes.content:
[b]Kart racing game 《LOLI RACING》 was officially launched on Steam on February 29.[/b]


[h3] Game content of official version 1.0.0 : [/h3]
[list]
[*] Single player and multiplayer
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/2f19e26bd4ab84f3bfce9ff2497b5678034e5f29.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 38 tracks with different themes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/05480af1327fed95371df57892064d8ba90a2bb1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 15 karts and characters
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860907/ff177b0859baaa1b08e1eb08c7972216ec5a51d8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Two modes : official match and practice match
[/list]

[h3]Version 1.0.6[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Startup options: For general player, please choose the first option
[*] Correct some text
[*] Change some UI icon
[*] Starting line number change
[*] Some map brightness correction
[*] Loading screen change
[*] Delete part of Event System
[/olist]

[h3]Version 1.0.8[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Modify some text content
[*] Some text has been corrected to bold
[*] Correct the width of some images
[*] Add textures to some objects
[*] Module that replaces some objects
[/olist]

[h3]Version 1.1.0[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fix in-game UI text spacing
[*] Restore some map arrow objects
[*] Increase the duration of some acceleration points
[/olist]

[b] If there are any bugs in the game, please report them, wish you all have a good time. [/b]

tags.balance_change: [*] Increase the duration of some acceleration points
